proves.claim: Add with --after once per id, and with comma and space separated text, files an item after all three ids in the order given.

cli.journeys-add-after.several-ids.why: Without it, a repeated or space separated --after would drop dependencies again and the item would start before its prerequisites land.

proves.claim: An --after id that names no item is refused with a message naming that id, never dropped silently.

cli.journeys-add-after.bad-id-refused.why: Without it, a repeated or space separated --after would drop dependencies again and the item would start before its prerequisites land.

proves.claim: Edit with --after once per id replaces the after list with all of them, and --after none still clears it.

cli.journeys-add-after.edit-repeats.why: Without it, a repeated or space separated --after would drop dependencies again and the item would start before its prerequisites land.
